purpose: How each table in the source PDFs is covered by the wiki. The wiki doctor rejects a page whose source_pages cites a table missing here, and checks that every must_contain string is still on the listed pages. Statuses: transcribed (every row carried over), generated (rendered from a data file and checked by the health check), rule-inventory (rule IDs checked against docs/rule-inventory.json), summarised (described, not carried over row by row; reason required), partial or not-covered (known gap; issue required, reported as a warning).
